exercises.title: Eight queens
exercises.task: Fill place: one queen per row, in every column that is not attacked, then the next row, then take the queen back before trying the next column. Run compares the number of solutions with the number of boards a brute force would try.
hints: A square (r, c) is attacked when col[c], diag[r+c] or anti[r-c+n] is true.
Set the three to true, call place(r + 1), set them back to false. Forgetting the last step is the classic bug: the board fills up with ghosts of queens already removed.
